name: Sikafloor-33 PurCem
paste:
SIKAFLOOR®-33 PURCEM®: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikafloor®-33 PurCem®, April 2023, Version 01.04 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/w/sikafloor_-33_purcem.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikafloor®-33 PurCem® where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.04).
1.2 Product description. Sikafloor Sikafloor®-33 PurCem® is a Polyutethane/Cement coating that provides a UV colour stable option for the Sikafloor PurCem HB-22 textured heavy duty system.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Food and Beverage production and Processing facilities.
    - In Commercial Food premises where UV stability for optimum appearance is important.
    - As a chemical resistant coating.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikafloor®-33 PurCem®
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: UV stable polyurethane pigmented finish coat for PurCem HB-22 system
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.04) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - ASTM D 4060: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Abrasion resistance (p.2).
    - ASTM D 3441: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Tensile adhesion strength (p.2).
    - AS 4585-2013: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Skid / slip resistance (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Totally UV Stable
    - Very low VOC
    - Non food tainting - odourless
    - Excellent chemical resistance
    - HACCP - Food grade approved as part of the PurCem HB-22 System.
    - Integrated with Sikafloor 31 PurCem coating componants - part B substitution only required.
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Pigmented coating. Refer to the Sikafloor PurCem colur range chart
    - Density: 1.40 kg /L
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Shore D Hardness: 80 - ASTM-2240
    - Abrasion resistance: 1.57 g - ASTM D 4060
    - Tensile adhesion strength: 1.75 Mpa - ASTM D 3441
    - Chemical resistance: Excellent resistance to a wide range of chemicals. Refer to PurCem Chemical resistance document.
2.7 Skid / slip resistance. Sikafloor PurCem systems cater for and conform to a range of textures as per P rating AS 4585-2013; These ratings depend on the requirement of a given facility and are generally P4- P5 for wet areas; Refer to Sika Techncial Dept for further information and documentation
2.8 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Shelf life: Part A 9 months; Part B 6 months; Part C 6 months; Pigment 9 months
    - Storage conditions: Store between +5 and +30 degrees
2.9 Packaging. 5.2kg kit: A+B+C+Pigment; Part A 1.3kg Part B 1.9kg Part C 1.6 kg Pigment 0.4kg; PurCem Accelerator: Required for installation temperature below 20 degrees C to achieve similar curing to Sikafloor 31PurCem- please refer to the below Sikafloor PurCem Accelerator Addition Guide: Temp 15 Degrees C - 200mls/5.2kg kit; Temp 10 Degrees C - 250mls/5.2kg kit

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.04) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.04) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Consumption: As a coating for Sikafloor HB-22 Textured system - approx 1.8 - 2.2 M2 per litre per coat (6.5 - 8.0 m2 per 3.71L kit )
    - Pot Life: 15-20 minutes at 20 degrees C
    - Curing time: Foot traffic - 24hrs ( at 20 degrees C); Vehicular traffic 36 h ( at 20degrees C); Full chemical cure 5 days (at 20 degrees C)
    - Waiting time to overcoating: 16h min / 48 h max (at 20 degrees C)
4.3 Mixing ratio. Only mix full kits of Sikafloor 33 PurCem and ensure the correct amount of PurCem accelerator is added as per the below guide. 5.2kg kit: A+B+C+Pigment; Part A 1.3kg Part B 1.9kg Part C 1.6 kg Pigment 0.4kg; PurCem Accelerator: Required for installation temperature below 20 degrees C to achieve similar curing to Sikafloor 31PurCem- please refer to the below Sikafloor PurCem Accelerator Addition Guide: Temp 15 Degrees C - 200mls/5.2kg kit; Temp 10 Degrees C - 250mls/5.2kg kit
4.4 Equipment.
    - For optimum results;
    - Apply with a centre shafted roller frame at least 350mm in width.
    - Roller knap length of 15mm minimum
4.5 Mixing.
    - Mixing will be affected by temperature; condition materials for use to 18 - 15 Degrees C.
    - 1. Add pigment to part A, stir for for approximately 15 seconds.
    - 2. Add component B, mix for approx 30 seconds.
    - 3. While mixing, add component C within 15 seconds. 4. Further mix for 2 minutes until the mixture is homogeneous and the pigment is uniformly dispersed.
    - 5. If required add the required amount of Sikafloor PurCem accelerator and mix for a further 30 seconds. Use material immediately
    - Note: Failure to follow the above may result in uneven gloss and or colour in the finished product APPLICATION
    - Apply evenly with correct roller and roller sleeves as decribed in Equipment section.
    - For best results on textured HB-22 systems, pour the product onto the surface in lines and apply out with a rubber tipped squeegee.
    - "Lay off" the excess with the rollers to create and even distribution in the texture.
    - Performing this then at a right angle will futher even out the product distribution .
4.6 Mixing - Note.
    - Mixing buckets should be discarded for new ones approx every 3-4 mixes at 20 degrees C.
    - Roller sleeves should be dicarded for new ones approx every 30 minutes at 20 degrees C.
    - Failure to do this will likely result in uneven texture and sheen in the finished product.
    - For lighter colours and or being applied on Broadcast B1 texture, consideration should be given to a second coat to ensure full colour distrbution.
4.7 Cleaning of equipment. Clean equipment with Sika Colma Cleaner
4.8 Further information.
    - Use of Accelerator in Sikafloor®-33 PurCem® is necessary to aid in curing in termperatures below approx 20 degrees C.
    - Refer to the dosage rates for guidence.
    - Protect the surface from traffic such as machinery assembly in production facilities with suitable barrier. Do not expose the Sikafloor®-33 PurCem® surface to high levels of acids and chlorines when plant is being commissioned.
    - This will result in staining of the surface. (refer to Sika Techncial document on passivation of plant and equipment)

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. Do not apply below 10 degrees C or above 30 degrees C
5.3 Relative air humidity. Maximum RH - 85%
5.4 Substrate moisture content. Apply on substrates below 10% surface moisture ( See Sikafloor HB-22 PurCem TDS )
5.5 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.6 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikafloor®-33 PurCem®, April 2023, Version 01.04, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/w/sikafloor_-33_purcem.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sikafloor 20/21/24/31/33 Purcem Part A, version 10/11/2022, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/1/Sikafloor%2021.24.29.31.33%20Purcem%20Part%20A.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Material Safety Data Sheet containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
6.4 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
